content.title: Euthyphro
content.author: Plato · translated by Benjamin Jowett
content.role: Primary record · not a teaching authority
content.note: Plato's dialogue in which Socrates asks whether the holy is loved by the gods because it is holy, or holy because it is loved: the source of the Euthyphro dilemma. A pagan text about many gods, cited for the question it poses, not as teaching. Public domain: may be quoted, with the translator named.
